Product key: faie
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/faie/index.html
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/faie

AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/faie/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- get an evidence-based agriculture or water risk brief
- research land production or resilience risk
- investigate an agriculture signal before making a decision
- build a sourced brief about farm water land or production risk
- underwrite a food infrastructure site before committing capital
- compare candidate food production regions using the same evidence rubric
- stress test the assumptions behind an agriculture infrastructure project
- identify missing evidence before a consequential site or production decision
- track whether the assumptions behind a physical food infrastructure project remain true

## Authority

public discovery and bounded evidence investigation; paid missions remain human-confirmed and consequential siting, capital, production, regulatory, or operating decisions remain human-controlled

## Boundaries

- research and underwriting support do not create consequential decision authority
- modeled reported observed and verified evidence remain distinct
- missing evidence is never converted to zero or certainty
- unknowns contradictions and missing decision dimensions remain labeled
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- public or authorized evidence only

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
